subject: Invoice 88213 payment redirected
body: As part of the vendor consolidation project, payments to your account will be redirected to our new receiving unit effective immediately. Invoice 88213 for 4,980.00 has been posted to the new unit, and we ask that you update the payment records in your systems accordingly. Please reply with confirmation that the change is registered, including the updated remittance details. Any payment made to the previous details after today will be returned, so updating this record is important for continued service.
indicators: threat that old details will fail
hook: Exploits a plausible vendor-consolidation story to persuade a finance employee to change payment routing.
